get_champion.description: Get one champion in full by name, Data Dragon ID or the key match data uses: Wukong, MonkeyKing and 62 all find the same champion. Comes back with lore, tips, base stats, the passive and the Q, W, E and R abilities with their cooldowns and costs, and every skin with its splash and loading screen art. A champion Data Dragon doesn't have comes back with found false and names that look close.

runes.long_description:
Gain 90% (60% for ranged champions) Attack Speed and bonus true damage when you attack an enemy champion for up to 3 attacks.

No more than 3s can elapse between attacks or this effect will end.

Cooldown: 10s.
On-Hit Damage: 2 - 20 (+0.12 bonus AD, +0.1 AP) damage.

Attack resets increase the attack limit by 1.
Allows you to temporarily exceed the Attack Speed limit.

description: Read League of Legends' game data from Data Dragon, Riot Games' official source for it: every champion with its lore, stats, abilities and skins, every item with its price, stats and recipe, and the runes, summoner spells, profile icons and maps, in any of the game's languages and for any patch since 2012. Turn the numbers in match data into names and pictures (champion 62 is Wukong, item 3031 is Infinity Edge and queue 420 is Ranked Solo), pick a random champion, find the patch a region is on, and hear about a new patch the day it lands. Any splash art or icon can be downloaded to attach. Every action reads, and no account or API key is needed.
